description.value: Great Mountain Ginseng is a specialty Chinese health food retailer focused on Canadian (American) ginseng, bird's nest, sea cucumber, and traditional Chinese herbal medicines, operating both an e-commerce store and a physical retail location in Richmond. The store is housed inside a shopping complex and offers in-store pickup alongside online orders. Touring cyclists could find dried goods, snack foods, specialty hot drink powders, and a range of health-focused food items here.
